events.name: SV Elversberg at 1. FC Union Berlin

headlines.description: Bayern Munich salvaged a 2-2 draw against Augsburg after a blunder from Manuel Neuer led to them conceding the fastest goal in Bundesliga history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bayern salvage point after early Neuer error

headlines.description: Bayern Munich warmed up for their Champions League showdown against Arsenal with a thumping 6-1 home victory over RB Leipzig to reclaim top spot in the Bundesliga.
headlines.shortLinkText: Díaz hat trick in 6-1 win sends Bayern top of Bundesliga

events.name: 1. FC Union Berlin at FC Augsburg

headlines.description: Bayern Munich returned to the top of the Bundesliga table thanks to a 3-1 away win at Freiburg on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bayern Munich hold off Freiburg in first game without Kompany
